about: Single source of truth for AI-generated art (ChatGPT web). The import script (tools/import_art.py) reads this to validate, rename, optimize and place every downloaded image. Keep it in sync with game.js: CITIES (cities + nightZones), THEMES (background seam), SPRITE_SRC (sprite seam). Adding a city/sprite = add a defaults-shaped entry here, write its prompt in prompts/chatgpt_image_batches.md, regenerate.

art_direction.style: Flat clean illustration, Survivors.io-grade polish. Bold simple shapes, limited flat color fills, soft cel shading, thin restrained dark outlines on characters only. NOT painterly, NOT photoreal, NOT pixel-art, NOT 3D render.
art_direction.palette_intent: Warm, saturated Indian street-food palette for FOOD/HERO; the world recedes (muted, slightly desaturated) so gameplay objects pop. Night zones cool down but keep warm lamp pools.
art_direction.readability_law: This is a top-down survivors-like. Backgrounds must read as a calm, low-contrast surface a grey enemy and a bright food token can sit ON TOP of and remain instantly legible. Busy, high-contrast, or noisy art that hides a grey blob = reject.
art_direction.consistency: All assets in a batch share one art direction so the cities feel like one game. Same outline weight, same shading logic, same horizon/lighting language across a city's day+night pair.
art_direction.forbidden_global: No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, UI, frames/borders, or signage with readable words. No real brand marks. No body-shape/health/diet messaging of any kind (hard brand rule).

background.fit: cover-crop (game cover-fits the master to the 9:16 arena; safe-zone the scene so cropping the sides/top loses nothing critical)

assets.scene: Top-down / steep three-quarter view of a wide-open Mumbai street-food lane. A big EMPTY central road running top-to-bottom (this is the play lane). Sides lined with small chaiwala stalls, a vada-pav cart, stacked crates, a clay matka pot, potted tulsi plants, a parked black-and-yellow Padmini taxi tucked at the very edge. Monsoon-damp warm tarmac. Faint kerb lines down both margins.
assets.mood_lighting: Warm overcast monsoon daylight, soft diffuse shadows, gently wet sheen on the road. Inviting, lived-in, slightly muted so it recedes.
assets.readability: Central 60% vertical band must be near-empty, low-contrast, low-detail road — a grey blob and a glowing food token must pop instantly on it. All props confined to the left/right margins. No strong highlights or busy texture in the play lane.
assets.style: Flat clean illustration, Survivors.io polish. Limited warm palette (sand/ochre road, terracotta + teal + mustard stall accents). Soft cel shading, no harsh outlines on environment.
assets.negative: NO puddles, NO water patches, NO quicksand, NO sand pits, NO hazards of any kind on the road (these are drawn by the game on top). No people/characters. No text, signs with words, logos, watermarks. No heavy clutter in the centre lane. No top-down grid/tile seams. No frame or border.
acceptance: Empty readable central lane spanning top-to-bottom; props only in side margins
Reads as Mumbai (taxi / stalls / monsoon-warm) at a glance
Aspect ~2:3, short edge >= 1024px, no transparency
Zero hazards, zero text/logos, no human characters

assets.level_scope: MUMBAI zone 4 (the night beat before the city boss)
assets.scene: The SAME Mumbai lane as bg-mumbai-day, at night. Same layout: empty central road, stalls/cart/crates/taxi in the margins, now lit by warm sodium street lamps and small stall bulbs casting pools of warm light down the edges. Deep blue-grey night road in the centre.
assets.mood_lighting: Night: cool deep blue-grey base, warm orange lamp pools hugging the side margins, the central lane darker but still clearly readable. Calm, slightly moody, not black.
assets.readability: Central lane stays the lightest-relative, low-detail readable surface despite the dark — a grey blob must still pop. Keep lamp pools and bright accents in the margins, never across the play lane.
assets.style: Same flat clean illustration + palette family as bg-mumbai-day, shifted to night. Identical layout and prop placement so day/night feel like one place.
assets.negative: NO puddles/water/hazards on the road (game-drawn). No people. No text/signs-with-words/logos/watermarks. No pitch-black unreadable centre. No neon-sign lettering. No frame/border.
acceptance: Clearly the same lane as the day version, at night
Central lane remains readable (not black); lamp pools only at margins
Aspect ~2:3, short edge >= 1024px, no transparency
Zero hazards, zero text/logos, no human characters

assets.scene: Top-down / steep three-quarter view of a wide-open sandstone lane in Jaisalmer (the Golden City). A big EMPTY central sandy path top-to-bottom (the play lane). Margins lined with carved golden-sandstone stall fronts, a wooden ghevar/kachori cart, woven baskets, stacked clay pots, a couple of potted desert shrubs, a resting camel tucked at the far edge. Pale golden desert daylight.
assets.mood_lighting: Hot, bright golden-hour desert daylight, warm sand tones, soft long shadows, slightly hazy. Muted enough to recede.
assets.readability: Central 60% vertical band must be near-empty pale-sand road, low-contrast — a grey blob and bright food pop on it. Props only in left/right margins. Avoid busy carved-stone detail spilling into the lane.
assets.style: Flat clean illustration, Survivors.io polish. Golden-sand + warm-stone palette with terracotta and dull-teal accents. Soft cel shading, no harsh environment outlines.
assets.negative: NO quicksand, NO sand pits, NO sinkholes, NO puddles, NO hazards on the path (game-drawn on top). No people. No text/Hindi-or-English signage/logos/watermarks. No clutter in centre lane. No tile seams. No frame/border.
acceptance: Empty readable central sand lane top-to-bottom; props only in margins
Reads as Jaisalmer (golden sandstone / desert / camel) at a glance
Aspect ~2:3, short edge >= 1024px, no transparency
Zero hazards, zero text/logos, no human characters

assets.level_scope: JAISALMER zone 4 (the night beat before the city boss)
assets.scene: The SAME Jaisalmer lane as bg-jaisalmer-day, under a clear desert night sky. Same layout: empty central sand path, sandstone stalls/cart/baskets/camel in the margins, lit by warm lantern glow at the stalls and a cool deep-blue moonlit sky. Sandstone catches faint warm lantern light at the edges.
assets.mood_lighting: Clear desert night: cool deep blue base, crisp moonlight, warm amber lantern pools hugging the margins. Calm and atmospheric, never pitch black.
assets.readability: Central sand lane stays the lightest-relative readable surface; a grey blob must still pop. Lantern warmth and detail stay in the margins.
assets.style: Same flat clean illustration + palette family as bg-jaisalmer-day, shifted to a cool desert night. Identical layout and prop placement.
assets.negative: NO quicksand/sand-pit/puddle/hazard on the path (game-drawn). No people. No text/signage/logos/watermarks. No pitch-black centre. No lantern lettering. No frame/border.
acceptance: Clearly the same lane as the day version, at night
Central lane remains readable; lantern pools only at margins
Aspect ~2:3, short edge >= 1024px, no transparency
Zero hazards, zero text/logos, no human characters

assets.scene: A single chibi Indian street-food courier, 'The Tiffin Runner'. Steep three-quarter top-down view (seen slightly from above and front, matching a survivors-like). Big head, small body (chibi, reads at small size). Red delivery cap with a saffron band, dark hair peeking out, warm brown skin, mustard shirt, tied cream apron (neck straps + waist bow + pocket), navy trousers. Holds a small 2-tier steel tiffin/dabba at the side (kept SMALL, must not dominate). Friendly, plucky. Facing toward the viewer / slightly down-screen.
assets.mood_lighting: Bright, warm, even lighting. Vibrant and saturated so the hero pops against muted streets. Soft single drop of cel shading.
assets.readability: Must read clearly at ~50px tall in-game. Bold silhouette, thin dark outline, minimal interior detail. Centered in frame with even margins.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration, Survivors.io-grade. Bold simple shapes, thin dark outline, flat fills + one soft shade. Chibi proportions.
assets.negative: NO background, NO scene, NO ground, NO shadow on ground — fully TRANSPARENT background. No text/logo. No oversized props (tiffin stays small). No multiple characters. No weapon. No extra limbs. Not cropped — whole character with margin. No drop shadow baked in.
acceptance: Single centered chibi courier on transparent background (has alpha)
Cap + apron + small tiffin all present and correctly proportioned (tiffin small)
Bold readable silhouette at small scale
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene

assets.level_scope: The Bland grunt (standard enemy, all cities)
assets.scene: A single 'Bland' — a smug grey lumpy blob creature. Fully desaturated grey (the anti-flavor). Smug face: angled brows, low beady pupils, a smug closed mouth with a tiny tongue, a couple of small drips. Slightly cute, love-to-hate. Standing, facing viewer. Chibi, simple.
assets.mood_lighting: Flat, slightly dull lighting — it is the colour-draining enemy, so it stays grey and matte while everything else is warm.
assets.readability: Must read as a distinct grey threat at ~40px against both warm day and dark night streets. Bold rounded silhouette, thin dark outline, clear face. Centered with margin.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration matching the courier's outline/shading language, but fully grey and desaturated.
assets.negative: NO background/scene/ground — fully TRANSPARENT. No colour (keep it grey/desaturated). No text/logo. No multiple blobs. Not cropped. No baked ground shadow.
acceptance: Single centered grey smug blob on transparent background (has alpha)
Desaturated grey, clear smug face, readable silhouette at small scale
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene

assets.scene: A single small spiky grey wisp — a fast little cousin of the Bland. Smaller, sharper, a few spiky points around a grey body, two tiny angry eyes, faint motion-energy. Reads as quick and aggressive. Same grey desaturated family. Centered, facing viewer.
assets.mood_lighting: Flat dull grey lighting, same anti-flavor look, with a slightly sharper/edgier read than the round grunt.
assets.readability: Tiny in-game (~24px). Silhouette must read as 'small + spiky + fast' and clearly distinct from the round grunt. Bold simple spikes, thin outline.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration, same language as the Bland grunt, but small, spiky and edgier. Grey/desaturated.
assets.negative: NO background/scene — fully TRANSPARENT. No colour. No text/logo. No multiple wisps. Not cropped. No baked shadow. Don't make it round like the grunt — keep it spiky/distinct.
acceptance: Single centered small spiky grey wisp on transparent background (has alpha)
Clearly distinct from the round grunt (spiky, smaller, edgier)
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene

assets.level_scope: THE BLANDFATHER (wave-5 mini-boss, shared across cities)
assets.scene: A single bigger, meaner Bland mob-boss — 'The Blandfather'. Same grey blob family but larger and tougher, wearing a dented grey mobster fedora/goon cap and sporting a grey mustache. Smug menacing read, slight scowl. Standing, facing viewer. Chibi-but-imposing.
assets.mood_lighting: Flat dull grey, faintly more contrast/shading than the grunt to feel weightier. Still desaturated anti-flavor grey.
assets.readability: Reads as 'boss version of the Bland' at ~70px — bigger silhouette, hat + mustache are the instant tells. Bold outline, clear hat shape.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration, same language as the Bland grunt, scaled up with goon-hat + mustache regalia. Grey.
assets.negative: NO background/scene — fully TRANSPARENT. No colour (grey only, hat may be a slightly darker grey). No text/logo. No multiple figures. Not cropped. No baked shadow. No weapons.
acceptance: Single centered grey mobster-blob with dented hat + mustache (has alpha)
Clearly a bigger 'boss' Bland, hat + mustache legible
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene

assets.level_scope: THE VADA MAHARAJA (Mumbai city boss, wave 8 of zone 5)
assets.scene: A single grand Bland city-boss — 'The Vada Maharaja', ruler of bland Mumbai. Big purple-grey blob body, a tall ornate gold crown, a curled royal mustache, an imperious smug expression. Largest and most decorated of the Bland bosses. Standing, facing viewer. Imposing but comic.
assets.mood_lighting: Mostly desaturated body with a regal purple-grey tint; the GOLD crown is the one warm accent (it pops as the prize/threat). Soft cel shading for weight.
assets.readability: Reads as the finale boss at ~90px. Gold crown is the instant tell against the grey body. Bold silhouette, clear crown.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration, same Bland family, scaled biggest with gold-crown + mustache regalia and a faint purple-grey royal tint.
assets.negative: NO background/scene — fully TRANSPARENT. Body stays grey/purple-grey (only the crown is gold). No text/logo. No throne/scene props. No multiple figures. Not cropped. No baked shadow.
acceptance: Single centered purple-grey blob with tall GOLD crown + royal mustache (has alpha)
Reads as the biggest, most decorated boss; crown legible
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene

assets.level_scope: THE DUNE RAJA (Jaisalmer city boss, wave 8 of zone 5)
assets.scene: A single grand Bland city-boss — 'The Dune Raja', desert ruler of bland Jaisalmer. Big sand-grey blob body, a layered desert turban (pagari) as the crown, an imperious smug expression. Largest desert boss. Standing, facing viewer. Imposing but comic.
assets.mood_lighting: Mostly desaturated body with a faint warm sand-grey tint; the layered turban carries warm desert ochre as the one accent. Soft cel shading.
assets.readability: Reads as the finale boss at ~90px. The tall layered turban is the instant tell. Bold silhouette, clear turban.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration, same Bland family, scaled biggest with a layered desert-turban headpiece and sand-grey body.
assets.negative: NO background/scene — fully TRANSPARENT. Body stays sand-grey/desaturated (turban may carry warm ochre). No text/logo. No scene props. No multiple figures. Not cropped. No baked shadow.
acceptance: Single centered sand-grey blob with a layered desert turban (has alpha)
Reads as the biggest desert boss; turban legible and distinct from the Vada Maharaja's crown
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene
